create_MPStat_monitor: create an MPStat monitor instance with a polling interval and job UUID for CPU monitoring
run_MPStat: run the MPStat monitor to start collecting CPU utilization metrics via mpstat subprocess
process_output_MPStat: process a line of mpstat output to extract timestamped CPU usage percentages into a dictionary
review_MPStat_process_output: review the MPStat process_output method to understand how mpstat CPU header and data lines are parsed
refactor_MPStat_headers: refactor the MPStat class to support per-CPU metrics in addition to aggregate all-CPU data
